title.zh: 将达迪安加斯北“A”小学更名为何塞·P·劳雷尔小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Dadiangas North "A" Elementary School to Jose P. Laurel Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Dadiangas North "A" Elementary School to Jose P. Laurel Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Dadiangas North "A" thành Trường tiểu học Jose P. Laurel
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Dadiangas North "A" เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Jose P. Laurel
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Dadiangas North "A" menjadi Sekolah Dasar Jose P. Laurel
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Dadiangas North "A" menjadi Sekolah Rendah Jose P. Laurel

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6706_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Dadiangas North "A" Elementary School in Cahilsot District, General Santos City, South Cotabato, shall hereafter be known and referred to as the Jose P. Laurel Elementary School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
